title: Microsoft Fluid Framework prague Uncontrolled Search Path Element Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Microsoft Fluid Framework. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the installation of Fluid Framework. When installed from the official Microsoft GitHub repository, the installation attempts to load a non-existent cloud resource that is vulnerable to takeover. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code on systems dependent on the cloud resource.
